Added lib/integrations/webhook-security.ts: constant-time safeCompare (fixed-width digest so no length leak, empty never matches), verifyHmacSignature, verifyPrefixedDigestSignature (wire-compatible with the existing partner digest), isWithinReplayWindow, and isUniqueViolation.

Replaced non-constant-time signature comparison on the four partner-provider routes with verifyPrefixedDigestSignature at the route trust boundary; the lib/music/*/partner-adapters helpers are no longer on any inbound boundary and were left untouched as out-of-lane.

Made a configured partner secret reject an absent signature with 400 Invalid signature instead of the misleading 503 Webhook not configured; the explicit *_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNSIGNED sandbox flag behavior is unchanged.

Replaced the Supabase notification webhook's read-then-deliver dedupe (no uniqueness on notification_delivery_log, so concurrent deliveries double-sent) with an atomic claim on public.webhook_delivery_receipts before any delivery, a bounded 300s reclaim for interrupted claims, a failed-claim release on delivery error, and a checked completion write; the pre-existing notification_delivery_log guard is retained for rows delivered before the ledger existed.

Authored additive forward-only migration 20260925130000_intg006_webhook_delivery_receipts.sql with a planned manifest: one new table, default-deny ACLs, service_role only, no existing object altered or dropped. NOT applied (CP-051).

Made the photos Stripe webhook fail closed with 500 when the platform_webhook_events completion write does not persist, so a provider retry resumes instead of a false 200 acknowledgement; the 42P01 degraded path still returns 200 without attempting a completion write.

Made the subscriptions Stripe webhook return 503 Webhook not configured before reading the body when its endpoint secret is absent, use the shared unique-violation primitive, correct the stale 'degrades gracefully if the table is unprovisioned' comment to match the fail-closed code, and stop logging raw Stripe/database error objects.

Added 75 behavioral route tests and 20 primitive tests covering, per hardened route: valid signature accepted, invalid signature rejected with zero side effects, replay rejected idempotently, duplicate concurrent delivery handled once, and malformed body rejected.
